part2.title: Collaborative Task - Places to Eat
part2.examinerSetup: Now, in this part of the test, you are going to talk together. Here are some pictures that show different places to eat. Do you like these different places to eat? Say why or why not. I'll say that again. Do you like these different places to eat? Say why or why not. Now, talk together.

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: say whether you like eating at a cafe and give a reason
turns.virtualFallback: I love eating at a cafe because the food there is delicious.
criteria: gives an opinion and a reason

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: respond with an opinion about eating at a restaurant
turns.virtualFallback: I like eating at a restaurant because there are lots of different dishes. What do you think?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: agree or disagree about restaurants and explain why
turns.virtualFallback: I don't always like restaurants because they can be crowded.

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: respond to the opinion about crowded restaurants
turns.virtualFallback: I don't mind when a restaurant is crowded because it may mean the food is good.

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: give an opinion about eating at home and explain why
turns.virtualFallback: My favourite place to eat is at home because it is comfortable and the food is nutritious.

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: respond about eating at home and ask about eating on the beach
turns.virtualFallback: Me too. I like eating at home because I can spend time with my family. Do you think eating on the beach is fun?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: answer the question about the beach and invite the partner's opinion
turns.virtualFallback: I think eating on the beach is fun because you can enjoy the waves and the wind. What do you think?

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: respond about the beach and ask about eating in the park
turns.virtualFallback: I think eating on the beach is nice because we can spend time with our family. Do you think eating in the park is nice?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: answer the question about the park and ask for the partner's opinion
turns.virtualFallback: I think eating in the park is nice because we can see other families enjoying themselves. What do you think?

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: give a final opinion about eating in the park
turns.virtualFallback: I think it is okay, but traffic near the park could make the air unpleasant.
criteria: gives an opinion about the park
